pinned_git_revision_note: recorded at pre-registration time; later runs compare authored-file hashes below, not live HEAD (sibling-experiment commits moving HEAD are not contamination)
target: local Apple M4 / G16G only; A18 Pro hands-off; no SSH anywhere
boundary: public Metal API; runtime MSL compile (newLibraryWithSource:); owned shared/private buffers and textures; read-only tools/iotrace/iotrace.c interposer (unmodified) for DATA-TRACE of this process's own IOKit boundary traffic and registered-BO snapshots; read-only tools/shdump/shdump.m + tools/shdump/agxparse.py (unmodified) for OWN-SHADER container extraction; no Apple binary/framework/kernel/firmware inspection
tools_ro_sha256_recorded_by: run.py provenance() at each run's 00_inputs.json (tools/iotrace/iotrace.c, tools/iotrace/README.md, tools/shdump/shdump.m, tools/shdump/agxparse.py)
gate_order: PRE_GPU: --selftest, --seqtest, --preflight --run-id run01, run.py run01; RUN01_PRESENT: --selftest, --seqtest, --between-runs --run01-id run01 --run02-id run02, run.py run02; RUN02_PRESENT: --selftest, --seqtest, --captured --run01-id run01 --run02-id run02
gate_smoke: run.py's SMOKE_CASE (cdm mode, count=2) executes into work/, not raw/, and its authored CDM signature must be found intact before raw/<run-id>/ is created; a smoke failure is a pre-capture STOP with no raw/ directory left behind
gate_cross_run: run01 and run02's 02_results.jsonl (the GATED file) must be byte-identical per case (same set of case names, and each case's JSON-decoded record equal) -- no address field is ever present in that file (schema.py:assert_no_address_leak, exercised by --selftest); raw addresses live only in the sibling 02_results_addrs.jsonl, which is NOT part of the cross-run gate and is expected to differ between runs
no_nondeterministic_field_in_gated_paylo: CDM/VDM segment facts are record counts, tail/link tags, and integer DELTAS relative to that same run's own zero-padding baseline case (schema.build_segment_records); the container-live CDM record is hex-encoded only after schema.normalize_cdm_record zeroes its one known per-dispatch-varying field (+0x08..+0x0b); state-packet bind-pair addresses are stored only as deltas from the pool base found within the same case; verify.py --selftest proves both normalizations produce byte-identical output across two synthetic runs whose absolute addresses differ by a real observed shift (0x4080000)
fixtures_note: verify.py --selftest and --seqtest fixtures are built entirely from RECORDED REALITY: the synthetic CDM chain shape (3 segments of up to 732 records, link tag 0x20, shift 0x4080000) is a literal reproduction of this experiment's own calibration observations (see PRE_REGISTRATION.md), not an invented shape
